race.comment: JUSTICA'S BONUS (2) has built strongly into this campaign, putting it all together here last start when obliterating his rivals. Full of confidence now and only rises a kilo off that with the 4kg claimer taking over. Can win again. KALOSYNI (7) dug deep to fend them off and resume a winner here on July 7. Was taken back from a wide draw last time but was good late. Backs up quickly in his first look at 1400m. Have to include. DREAMS FULFILLED (5) doesn't win out of turn but has been warming nicely late. If the pace is genuine he can launch late and grab them. KORATORA (8) will appreciate dropping back to this level and draws well for Crowther. Her peaks measure up, just needs to find it.
